en-US.name: Cashly: Expenses & Budget
en-US.subtitle: Track spending, plan the month
en-US.promotionalText: Plan the month, record in seconds and keep your data yours. Budgets, insights and a Journey that turns good money habits into a game.
en-US.whatsNew: The first Cashly: plan the month, record in seconds and keep your data yours.
en-US.description:
Cashly helps you plan the month, record spending in seconds and see where your money goes. Your data stays on your devices and in your own iCloud: no account, no ads, no tracking.

PLAN THE MONTH
• Budgets by category with a pace bar that shows if spending is on track
• Bills and expected income, with reminders on the due date
• Goals for every month

RECORD IN SECONDS
• Add an expense from the app, a widget, Siri, Shortcuts, Control Center or the Action button
• Wallet capture: an automation catches each card payment and you only pick the category
• Split a cost equally, by percentage or by a fixed amount
• Any currency, converted at the rate of the day

BUILD THE HABIT
• Journey: levels, streaks, missions and challenges
• Widgets and Live Activities for budgets, bills and streaks
• Fourteen short guides, from the first expense to backups

YOUR DATA, YOUR WAY
• iCloud sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro
• Export to a backup or a spreadsheet anytime, for free
• Face ID lock and a discreet mode that hides amounts
• Ten languages

CASHLY PRO
Recording, editing, the Journey and exporting are free forever. Cashly Pro adds:
• Analyses and forecasts: month projection, unusual spending, recurring charges, where you can save and what is coming next
• On-device intelligence: budget and category suggestions, and a Cashly Summary written by Apple Intelligence on supported devices
• Automatic backups and imports from backups and spreadsheets
• Claude Code connection, with your approval for every request
• Exclusive icons and avatars

Start with a 7-day free trial, then choose monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://cashly.byescaleira.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://cashly.byescaleira.com/privacy

review.notes:
Cashly needs no account. All data is stored on the device and in the user's private iCloud database.

Cashly Pro (cashly.pro.monthly, cashly.pro.yearly, 7-day free trial) unlocks analyses on the Home tab, on-device intelligence, automatic backups, imports and the Claude Code connection. Recording, editing, the Journey and exporting are free. To reach the paywall: Settings > Cashly Pro, or any Cashly Pro card on Home. Restore is on the paywall.

The Journey tab has a shop with non-consumable icon, color and avatar packs and consumable Journey helps (streak freezes, streak restore, challenge rerolls). Open it from Journey > See the Shop.

Claude Code connection (Settings > Claude Code, Pro, off by default): when the user turns it on, the app listens on the device (and, only if the user also allows it, on the local network) so Claude Code on the user's own computer can read data and propose transactions. Every connection and every import requires approval inside the app. This is why the app declares local network usage and Bonjour.

Exchange rates come from free public APIs (jsDelivr currency-api, Cloudflare Pages mirror, Frankfurter); only currency codes and dates are sent.

To see sample data quickly, add a few expenses with the + button in History.
